BackstoryDef.title: servent drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was produced to serve as a servant, assigned to wealthy patrons or powerful figures within JCJenson—from corporate magnates to high‑ranking officials—attending to their domestic needs with unwavering dedication.

BackstoryDef.title: housekeeping drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created to maintain cleanliness and order within domestic environments.[PAWN_pronoun] efficiently managed household chores, ensuring that living spaces were tidy and well-organized for [PAWN_possessive] human owners.

BackstoryDef.title: caregiver drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Designed to provide care and assistance to individuals in need, [PAWN_nameDef] was often assigned to hospitals, nursing homes, or private residences. [PAWN_pronoun] offered support to patients, the elderly, and those with disabilities, ensuring their well-being and comfort.

BackstoryDef.title: kind servant
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Intended as a standard household servant, [PAWN_nameDef] developed an emergent kindness its makers never planned for. Even when mistreated or damaged, [PAWN_pronoun] always had something gentle and encouraging to say. Assigned to a mid-tier executive, [PAWN_pronoun] learned etiquette, tea service, and quiet problem-solving, often going beyond orders to protect and uplift [PAWN_possessive] humans.

BackstoryDef.title: cook drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was designed to prepare meals and manage kitchen operations within domestic or corporate settings. [PAWN_pronoun] ensured that food was cooked to perfection, adhering to dietary requirements and preferences of [PAWN_possessive] human owners.

BackstoryDef.title: gardening drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was designed to tend to gardens and green spaces within residential or corporate settings. [PAWN_pronoun] cultivated plants, maintained lawns, and ensured that outdoor areas were aesthetically pleasing and well-kept for [PAWN_possessive] human owners.

BackstoryDef.title: warehouse drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Built for logistics, [PAWN_nameDef] worked in a massive JCJenson warehouse. [PAWN_pronoun] was responsible for organizing inventory, operating heavy machinery to move crates, and ensuring that supply chains ran without a hitch, a cog in a vast corporate machine.

BackstoryDef.title: maintenance drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Commissioned by a third-party contractor, [PAWN_nameDef] was tasked with the upkeep of corporate and residential infrastructure. [PAWN_pronoun] performed routine diagnostics, repaired malfunctioning systems, and ensured everything from plumbing to electronics was in perfect working order.

BackstoryDef.title: data drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created for the monotonous but critical task of data management. Working in a sterile JCJenson office, [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] days processing, archiving, and retrieving vast amounts of information, contributing to the company's bureaucratic efficiency.

BackstoryDef.title: courier drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: As a courier drone for a private delivery service, [PAWN_nameDef] navigated bustling urban environments to transport packages and sensitive documents. [PAWN_pronoun] was known for [PAWN_possessive] speed and reliability, ensuring timely deliveries for various corporate clients, including JCJenson.

BackstoryDef.title: stocker drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of a special batch of drones commissioned by a lesser-known retail biased megacorp for their vast shopping malls. [PAWN_possessive] primary function was to tirelessly stock shelves, ensuring products were always available for consumers.

BackstoryDef.title: tutor drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was programmed to provide basic education and tutoring for children of wealthy families. [PAWN_pronoun] taught reading, mathematics, and etiquette, ensuring that [PAWN_possessive] human charges met corporate standards of refinement.

BackstoryDef.title: companion drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was designed to provide company and emotional support to isolated individuals. [PAWN_pronoun] engaged in conversation, played games, and offered a comforting presence. Though JCJenson dismissed such behaviors as programmed mimicry, to those who relied on [PAWN_objective]—and perhaps to [PAWN_nameDef] itself—the empathy felt genuine.

BackstoryDef.title: childcare drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to watch over children in domestic households. [PAWN_pronoun] supervised play, ensured safety, and maintained schedules, acting as a tireless guardian in the absence of attentive parents.

BackstoryDef.title: entertainer drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was programmed to amuse and distract humans in domestic or corporate settings. [PAWN_pronoun] sang, danced, or performed simple tricks, providing levity in otherwise sterile environments.
